lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately five to six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-luminance horizontal and vertical bands intersect to form a grid-like matrix where circular blobs are positioned at the nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance peaks to low-luminance shadow troughs.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex vermiculated or maze-like pattern of high-luminance lines is present in the anterior region dorsal to the gills. Additionally, a cluster of approximately 15-20 high-intensity yellow pixel groups (representing associated fish) is visible near the anterior ventral area.
